output.rationale: The requirement specifies redundancy at both the utility/substation level (2N) and rack level (N+1). The EP2-RPP product from the EP2 business unit is suitable for substation-level redundancy as it provides relay and protection panels tailored to utility and substation needs. The FPM-SHELF product from the FPM business unit meets the rack-level redundancy requirement with its N+1 power supply configuration. These products together address the specified redundancy requirements.
